blocks.text: It is nice to be slender, or well-built. It is necessary to exercise your body and eat a well-balanced diet to keep your body in good shape. You look happier and healthier. But it is also important to exercise your _mind_ by reading books that help you become a better person day by day. When you are fat or too heavy, you aren’t very happy. It is easy to get sick or feel bad. For this reason, it is important to take care of yourself.
